user.title: Set up ESP32 PhotoFrame
user.description:
Enter the connection details for your PhotoFrame device.

💡 Tip: If the device appears offline and is battery-powered, press the BOOT button to wake it up.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your PhotoFrame device
data_description.ha_url: The URL where Home Assistant can be accessed, used by the PhotoFrame to fetch images
data_description.password: Only needed if you enabled password protection on the PhotoFrame's own web interface. Leave blank otherwise.

confirm.title: Confirm PhotoFrame Setup
confirm.description:
Device name: **{device_name}**

Click Submit to add this PhotoFrame to Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect:
Failed to connect to PhotoFrame. Please check the IP address/hostname and ensure the device is powered on.

💡 If battery-powered: Press the BOOT button to wake up the device.
error.duplicate_device_name: A PhotoFrame with this device name is already configured. Please change the device name on the PhotoFrame (via web interface or config) and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The PhotoFrame rejected the password. Check the password set on the device's web interface and try again.

abort.already_configured: This PhotoFrame device is already configured

init.title: PhotoFrame options
init.description: Set the password if you have enabled password protection on the PhotoFrame's own web interface. Leave blank if it is not protected.

data_description.password: Leave blank if the PhotoFrame does not require a password
